what: Item Type written into 3,618 master rows that had none (of 3,821 — master-list audit finding, rule type-missing), 2026-09-30. Bachmann (2,150 rows on seven tabs): the type comes from Bachmann's own product-page category (breadcrumb, read 2026-09-30 from shop.bachmanntrains.com) for 1,830 rows, and from the words of the product name for 320 rows whose category is mixed (Thomas rolling stock, circus, narrow gauge). Every other tab (Lionel modern 1,306, MTH 175, LGB 78, Micro-Trains 74, USA Trains 18, K-Line 11, Menards 9): fifteen plain-English word rules in a fixed order (listed under 'rules'), engines through the app's own steam/diesel reader after a model-name check. Every word written is one the app's bucketer already knows. 203 rows left blank on purpose (listed under 'left_blank'): merchandise (shirts, caps, mugs — no honest type word), Micro-Trains rows whose description is only a colour, a few unreadable names. Applied from the app in Brad's Chrome: one cell first and read back, then batches; every cell read back; every other cell on the 20 tabs read back unchanged. Cells are [tab, sheet row at the time (a hint), item number (column A), type written, decided by]; the identity is tab + item number + the blank Item Type cell. [stated] Brad: 'lets do no type next' → the plan and the review workbook (TYPE_PLAN_2026-09-30.xlsx) → 'go'. Master Version 1.89.
